page.overview:
Who is Daizen Matsushige?

Daizen had committed various thefts and murders during his time as a thief. He had once encountered a shinobi, the father of Hibiki and Kodama, who he had killed, though not before the latter left a cross shaped scar on his chest. Daizen would later start a new life owning a grocery shop in Konoha.

A fugitive from justice, Daizen pretended to be a respectable person, doing business in the store and helping the local old ladies, earning their respect. He has also shown a fake love for cats, allegedly worrying about Mikazuki running away from Mitsuki, but in reality throwing stones at them. Daizen is cruel and arrogant, willing to blame others for his crimes, stating that he "would not tolerate false accusations". He laughed at Hibiki and Kodama's accusations, and decided to become famous by killing them, earning praise for taking out criminals who had been attacking former shinobi.

Daizen is a portly man of medium height with brown eyes, a large nose, and short, dishevelled hair that is shaved at the bottom of his head. When working in a shop, he wears a white shirt, black pants, plain sandals, and a green apron with a badge on the chest. In battles, Daizen prefers a blue suit with one large button on the jacket. He also has a cross-shaped scar on his chest, which he disguises.

As a former shinobi, Daizen successfully stole and killed for many years, hiding his involvement by pretending to be a witness to his own crimes. He deduced that attacks on former shinobi were targeting him, and researched how they were attacked to prepare himself, successfully countering their sleeping gas, and tricking Hibiki and Kodama close enough to attack. He is good at close combat and fought with a kunai against two sword fighters.
